scope: Fixed-condition typical aggregate THD versus explicitly named manufacturer graph input-level axis; no audio transfer.
prior_inspection: The primary page was already inspected qualitatively in v4 and its U shape was known. This pass inspected retained p76/p77 images and selected/read source pixel coordinates before freezing this design. No oracle, candidate signal or numerical THD evaluation has been constructed or run.

axis.dbm_voltage_reference: Unresolved: retained p76 does not define 0 dBm as a particular Vrms. No voltage/power conversion is provided by the oracle.

readings.method: Manual centerline readings on retained raster, assisted by coordinate overlay and inspected dark-pixel runs; no curve fit or target/audio feedback. Denser supported points near the visible rising branch. Half-pixel centers are retained exactly. The steep trace has larger vertical ink thickness; horizontal reading scenarios are retained explicitly, not misrepresented as a full physical bound.

unsupported.reason: Vertical grid ink confounds a distinct centerline at this initially considered column; excluded rather than assigned or shifted.

readings.unread_extent: No point at or beyond x1170 is used: near-vertical trace/grid overlap cannot establish a stable centerline at the visual high-level endpoint. There is no extrapolation to 0 dBm or to the axis maximum.

ports.input: input_level_axis_dbm: numeric coordinate on this manufacturer graph, not an identified PSS780 signal voltage or inferred load power.
ports.voltage_reference: Explicit supply voltages are relative to chip GND/VSS=0 V. Input AC bias is unspecified by this panel.
ports.conditions_policy: Every condition and axis-reference label is mandatory. Exact rational VGG14/3 and its sole correctly rounded binary64 alias are accepted without coercing nearby rationals; every other condition is exact. No operating tolerances inferred.
unspecified: output pin joining and measurement load
analyzer noise subtraction and harmonic phases

oracle.nominal: Exact-rational piecewise-linear interpolation through the frozen pixel readings, mapped by the two linear axes. This is an explicit graph-reading approximation.
oracle.reading_scenarios: Enumerate64 corners: each of four axis endpoints shifts by +/-1px, and requested horizontal/vertical trace coordinates by +/-3px. Return minimum/maximum of these declared reading scenarios plus nominal. This is neither device spread, statistical confidence nor a bound over all continuous traces within boxes.
oracle.support: Common input-level support where every horizontal axis/trace corner remains inside measured pixel knots. Reject extrapolation. Nominal raw support and conservative common support both reported with exact rationals; binary64 public endpoints rounded inward.
oracle.comparison: Optional supplied aggregate THD is classified below/within/above declared graph-reading scenarios at an otherwise valid fixed-condition query. Classification is not hardware pass/fail or a bound on manufactured parts.
excluded: Noise synthesis or a THD-floor cause
Clock, temperature, supply, load or frequency scaling
Physical device tolerance or extrapolated overload

required: Every supported knot and independent axis conversion
Independent exact-rational interpolation and all64 corners at fixed query grid
Exact rational VGG and sole binary64 alias; adjacent/nearby rational rejection
Explicit missing/invalid/nonfinite/bool ports and exact fixed conditions
Reading-scenario shape comparison at preselected levels -18,-12,-4,-2 dBm; may report only supported levels
Standalone check receipt written without overwrite
